basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-year-old strategy game enthusiast from Seattle, WA. I work as a software developer, which keeps me busy during the weekdays, but I make sure to unwind with some gaming or catching up on my favorite shows at night. I'm a big fan of esports and recently got into collecting baseball cards. Although I'm single, I'm very social and enjoy discussing game strategies and sharing tips with others. My online hours are usually in the evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, having earned my degree from the University of Washington. My interest in gaming started early in my teens, and I've been an avid gamer ever since. My expertise lies in strategy games, which I've honed through years of playing and learning from online communities.
